name: loomground-governance-roles
description: Seven governed roles for the loomground ecosystem — grounder, legal-reasoner, knowledge-steward, lock-steward, policy-officer, auditor, local-grounder. Each is a universal skill carrying a skill-governance-block in its manifest frontmatter; an enforcement host enforces the block (a signed verdict on its hash-chain), ctrl plans on it, the agent-registry records it. The official/private firewall keeps the product grounder on official versum only while the local-grounder serves the private folder, firewalled.
